description:
Design a horizontal-axis wind turbine (HAWT) blade in QBlade that uses two distinct airfoils: NACA 4421 for the root and NACA 4412 for the tip. 

1. Generate both NACA 4421 and NACA 4412 airfoils using the NACA Generator.
2. Run XFoil polar analysis for BOTH airfoils (Re=1,000,000, Alpha -5 to 20).
3. Extrapolate both polars to 360 degrees.
4. Enter the HAWT Blade Design module and create a blade (length ~5m, ~10 stations).
5. Assign the NACA 4421 (or its polar) to the inner root sections and NACA 4412 to the outer tip sections.
6. Distribute chord and twist appropriately (tapering from root to tip).
7. Save the complete project to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/multi_airfoil_blade.wpa'.
